capabilities: Turn any note into a folder's table of contents
Expand folders and notes to browse headings and jump to them
Drag items to reorder without renaming or moving files
Create notes, folders or canvases inside a folder
Sort numbers naturally, including Chinese numerals
extras: Order and links are stored in the plugin's own data.json, so notes are untouched and uninstalling restores the original look. UI follows Obsidian's language (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish). Drag-to-reorder does not work on phones; use Move up / Move down in the context menu.
motivation: The author wanted one page per project to see the structure, reorder things and create new notes without digging through the sidebar all day.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer only sorts by name and folders can only be expanded or collapsed, so there is no single page per project to see structure, reorder items, and create notes.
summary: Turns any note into a folder's table of contents with a collapsible tree, drag-to-reorder, and in-place creation of notes, folders and canvases.
